aboutIntro: Software Engineer and full-stack MERN developer with a BSCS foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, databases, and software engineering. Builds RESTful APIs and database-backed applications with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and MySQL; experienced in JWT/RBAC, automated testing, and deterministic recommendation systems. IBM-certified with a 3.7/4.0 CGPA.

aboutBullets.text: Pursuing **BS in Computer Science** at Sindh Madressatul Islam University (CGPA 3.7/4.0, Sep 2022 – Jun 2026).
Certified **IBM Full-Stack JavaScript Developer** via Coursera.
Completed **MERN Stack Development Internship** at 10Pearls (10Shine Program), building REST APIs, MySQL data models, and Mocha/Chai test suites.
Engineered full-stack platforms including a **Smart Complaint Management System** (RBAC state machine), **Notes Platform**, and **NodeMart** marketplace.
Built and deployed **10+ full-stack MERN applications** applying core OOP, relational/NoSQL databases, and automated testing workflows.
